globalUsage.replacementGate: Only the social-group hero remains AI placeholder media and must be replaced with an owner-approved Xerom photograph before production launch.
globalUsage.astro: Import each 1200px or 1600px master through astro:assets; Astro generates optimized AVIF/WebP outputs. The checked-in 800px and 480px JPEGs are verified responsive fallbacks and portable derivatives.

buttons, icons, navigation, availability and booking feedback

socialGroupHero.alt: Illustrative placeholder of friends enjoying a sim-racing session; replace with approved Xerom photography before launch.
socialGroupHero.cropGuidance: Keep all five faces and the driver's hands visible. Trim peripheral venue detail first on narrow crops.

provenance.derivation: JPEG derivatives generated with macOS sips.
provenance.prompt: Create a candid, energetic photo of a diverse Malaysian friend group enjoying a social sim-racing session together in an anonymous contemporary gaming venue, matching the approved comp's cinematic black-and-red visual world without copying its layout or branding. Dark indoor venue with abstract red linear ceiling lights and indistinct racing stations. Five young adult friends gathered naturally around one seated driver with genuine shared excitement. Photorealistic candid editorial event photography, wide 16:9, controlled low-key exposure, no text, logos, trademarks, readable game UI, equipment claims, watermark, or documentary implication.

regularRig.alt: Close-up of the Fanatec control on Xerom's Regular Rig.
regularRig.cropGuidance: Preserve the black control, reflected blue light, and visible Fanatec marking; desktop/tablet 16:9 cards use object-position 43% 58%, while phone rows use center.
regularRig.derivation: Focal crop to 4672×3504 at vertical offset 2450, then proportional JPEG resampling with no stretching.

proRig.alt: Close-up of the Porsche-branded wheel centre on Xerom's Pro Rig.
proRig.cropGuidance: Keep the Porsche crest fully visible with the white light bars as secondary context.
proRig.derivation: Focal crop to 4672×3504 at vertical offset 2250, then proportional JPEG resampling with no stretching.

ps5Lounge.alt: Two PS5 controllers ready in front of the Xerom lounge screen.
ps5Lounge.cropGuidance: Keep both controllers, especially the foreground controller, within the frame; the blurred screen may remain contextual.
ps5Lounge.derivation: Focal crop to 4672×3504 at vertical offset 2950, then proportional JPEG resampling with no stretching.

cafe.alt: Three colourful drinks from the Xerom cafe.
cafe.cropGuidance: Keep all three cups and the centre Xerom mark visible; preserve the dark negative space above them.
cafe.derivation: Focal crop to 4672×3504 at vertical offset 3100, then proportional JPEG resampling with no stretching.
